subject: Launch spike: temporary quota uplift and retro discount request
messages:
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@brightlaunch.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@brightlaunch.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: Launch spike — temporary quota uplift and invoice question

Hi Rishi / Laura,

Quick note from our side — we pushed a marketing campaign late last night and saw a 6x spike in inference volume overnight. The platform handled it, but we blew through our daily concurrency and token thresholds and are now seeing an overrun estimate on the bill for ~USD 18,400 for 04/06–04/07.

We have two asks: 1) Can Redwood provision a short-term quota headroom for the rest of the week to avoid throttling (we expect elevated traffic for 48–72 hours), and 2) can you confirm whether BrightLaunch can get a retroactive credit or discount for this overrun — the spike was driven by an unplanned but brand-critical campaign.

I attached the stack metrics export for the spike window (stack_metrics_20270406.csv). Our procurement contact is listed below if you need PO info.

Procurement: Jenna Milo <j.milo@brightlaunch.com>
PO#: PL-98764 (pending)

Thanks,
Sam
——
Sam Torres
Head of Platform
BrightLaunch
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@brightlaunch.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Launch spike — temporary quota uplift and invoice question

Sam — thanks for the heads up and for the metrics export. Good news: we can support a provisional uplift to avoid throttling while we sort billing.

Options I can offer quickly (to get you unblocked within the hour):
- Short-term uplift: +3x concurrency and a temporary headroom for 72 hours. Immediate activation; no infra change on your side.
- Provisional credit: we can apply a one-time retro credit of 35% against the overrun charges if BrightLaunch signs a 3-month stepped-commit addendum (simple amendment to the current contract).
- Blended invoice approach: charge the overrun at a blended rate (60% of standard overrun) for this incident and reconcile on the next invoice with a line-item true-up depending on commit decision.

If you want a more concessionary path, I can loop in Ben for discretionary pricing approval. To proceed I need: an estimated PO timeline (Jenna) and whether you can commit to at least a short-term uplift/commit conversation in the next 5 business days.

I'll provision the +3x headroom now and set an automatic rollback at 2027-04-10T11:00:00-07:00 unless we hear from you. Attaching a provisional_pricing_sheet.pdf with the blended math (stated rates are provisional).

Next steps: confirm PO contact and preferred path (credit vs blended rate) and we'll send a formal amendment/DocuSign.

Best,
Rishi
Senior Account Strategist
Redwood Inference

-- Attachment: provisional_pricing_sheet.pdf (pdf, 42KB) --
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-08T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Launch spike — temporary quota uplift and invoice question

Looping in quick sales perspective. I reviewed the numbers and talked to pricing. Two tactical proposals that we can move on fast: 

1) Discretionary retro credit: 30% of the overrun now contingent on a signed 90-day stepped-commit (minimum $60k total commit across the term). This is faster from legal and finance.
2) If BrightLaunch needs a cleaner bookkeeping approach, we can do the blended rate + provisional credit (Rishi's approach) but cap the blended uplift to 1.5x standard rate rather than full overrun.

Also recommend we include a short SLA addendum for the uplift window (guarantee no throttling at the uplifted level) and a one-time invoice hold until the amendment is signed (45 days max) to ease procurement. Finance will need PO# PL-98764 or a confirmed email from Jenna.

If BrightLaunch signs by 04/15 we can lock the 30% credit and set the headroom live immediately. Otherwise we default to the blended invoice reconciliation.

Ben
Account Executive — Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference

Thanks — appreciate the quick response and the provisional headroom, Rishi. BrightLaunch is comfortable moving forward with the 30% retro credit contingent on the 90-day stepped-commit. Jenna expects to have an approved PO by 04/13.

A few requests to include in the amendment/quote:
- Explicit call-out of the uplift window (start 04/07 11:00 PDT, auto-rollback 04/10 11:00 PDT unless otherwise extended).
- SLA note: no throttling for requests within uplifted profile during the uplift window.
- Billing: we need the invoice held for up to 45 days while PO is finalized; please include a single line item for the credit so our accounting can process properly.

Please send the DocuSign quote and amendment to Jenna Milo <j.milo@brightlaunch.com> and cc me. If you can send the DocuSign today we can expedite internally.

Sam
